source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Use Ireasoning MIB browser professional:
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Open Ireasoning MIB browser, load the MIB files.
4. Setup the settings of MIB browser to access BMC according to the WEB UI SNMPv3 settings.
5. Left-click on the $target and expand subtree.
6. Right-Click on the node and use "Get Next" or "Get Subtree" to get all the values of the $target.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
Use NetSNMP to check.
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Put the mib files into the netsnmp search path.
http://www.net-snmp.org/docs/FAQ.html#Where_should_I_put_my_MIB_files_
4. Use NetSNMP "get type" of command(s) to retrieve the values of the $target from BMC.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: snmpwalk (net-snmp), BMC SNMP agent must be enabled + community configured
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- SNMP "monitor_users" monitoring reads specific BMC MIB data via the SNMP agent; from a 2nd management host run `snmpwalk -v2c -c ${SNMP_COMMUNITY:?operator must set SNMP community (v2c) or v3 creds} "$BMC_IP" .1.3.6.1.4.1.8072.2.3.2.1.2 | grep -i users (or walk the vendor MIB subtree once the SNMP community/v3 creds + MIB are configured). Enable + point SNMP agent first.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL snmpwalk output for the users OID subtree so the user confirms the monitor_users SNMP data is correct.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: SNMP queries need a management host + enabled/configured SNMP agent on the BMC (community/v3 + firewall); enabling SNMP is a config change, and some BMC SNMP sets expose credentials - use read-only community.

original_test_intent: Read approved BMC user-account metadata through SNMPv3 and compare it to a known account/role baseline without exposing secrets.
original_method: Engineer enables v3/account and browses undefined `$target`; Criteria change client and provide no field list.
manual_activity: Engineer configures WebUI/v3 account; safe field collection and comparison can be automated only after the disclosure boundary is approved.
safety_requirements: Never collect password hashes, keys, auth material or unrestricted subtrees.
Use least-privilege v3 and redact identities as required.
Do not substitute v2c or alter users/roles.
Restore temporary account; no auto retry.
agent_execution_scope: After correction, query only allowlisted objects and compare redacted metadata.
Do not create/modify accounts, operate WebUI or decide verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve object/field/baseline/redaction contract and configure/restore v3.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic v2c subtree plus full-output instruction may disclose secrets and cannot prove user semantics.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use exact allowlisted SNMPv3 objects and redact before persistence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IReasoning, `$target`, Net-SNMP criterion and 10/5-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Query only approved username surrogate, enabled state and role fields; compare to baseline and verify no secret object is accessible.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor user MIB and security guide.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds allowlist/redaction and negative disclosure check.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Account enumeration itself may be sensitive.

project_override_considerations: Projects may hash or pseudonymize account identifiers while retaining role/state comparison.
expected_evidence: Proof no secret fields were captured

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Client/security mode changes across Procedure, Criteria and DeepSeek; `$target` and permitted user fields are absent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Allowlist, redaction policy and baseline are required inputs; after manual setup, bounded collection is automatable.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Centers the block on data scope and secrecy, not tooling.

review_improvement: Introduces field allowlisting and negative secret-disclosure evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: User-management MIBs can reveal sensitive material. With no target or field boundary, even read-only automation creates an unacceptable disclosure risk and an unjudgeable result.
